One technology partner, from first requirement to ongoing support

Zeus System Technologies helps individuals, businesses, and institutions select, implement, maintain, and improve their technology systems. That covers the full range, from IT support and networks to software, websites, hardware, and security systems.

We also supply hardware and software, so the equipment and applications you need can come from the same team that sets them up and supports them.

What we do

Six core service areas, plus training, covering the technology your organization or home relies on.

IT Managed Services

Ongoing technical support and management of your IT environment, so issues are handled and systems stay in working order.

Web Development

Website design and development, hosting, and web-based applications for businesses and organizations.

Software Development

Custom software designed, built, tested, implemented, and maintained around the way you work.

IT Infrastructure, Cloud and Networking

Servers, networks, and cloud services planned, set up, and managed to keep your operations connected.

Hardware Sales, Repairs and Maintenance

Servers, desktops, laptops, and peripherals supplied, installed, repaired, and maintained.

Home Automation and CCTV

Home automation, CCTV, and surveillance systems installed for homes and business premises.

Technology Training

Technology training for individuals, teams, and organizations, so the people using your systems can use them well.

Why choose Zeus

These are the commitments we work to, whatever the size of the project.

  • Solutions tailored to your needs

    We start with what you need to achieve and recommend technology to match, rather than fitting you into a fixed package.

  • Support across technology disciplines

    Infrastructure, software, web, hardware, and security are handled by one company, so you can work with a single partner instead of coordinating several suppliers.

  • Practical implementation and maintenance

    We set systems up properly and remain available after installation for maintenance and technical support.

  • Reliability, security, and efficiency

    Our recommendations aim for systems that stay dependable, protect your data and premises, and reduce wasted effort.

  • Support for individuals and organizations

    Whether you are a household, a small business, or a government institution, we give your requirements the same careful attention.

Who we serve

Technology needs differ between a household, a growing business, and a public institution. We work with all of them.

  • Small and medium-sized businesses

    Dependable IT, websites, and software that fit the size and budget of a growing business.

  • Corporate organizations

    Infrastructure, networking, and managed support for larger environments with many users.

  • Government and public-sector institutions

    Technology supply, systems, and support for public institutions.

  • Educational and training organizations

    Equipment, systems, and technology training for schools and training providers.

  • Individuals and households

    Computer repairs, equipment, home automation, and CCTV for your home.

How we work

A straightforward process, from the first conversation to long-term support.

  1. 1

    Understand your needs

    We listen first, learning how you work and what you need technology to do.

  2. 2

    Recommend the right solution

    We propose practical options that fit your requirements and budget.

  3. 3

    Implement and configure

    We supply, install, build, and configure the solution so it is ready to use.

  4. 4

    Support, maintain, and improve

    We keep systems running and help you improve them as your needs change.
